review_scope: Read-only runner/source inspection and standard-library comparisons of existing JSON, AST and prompt bytes; no probe rerun, model, API, environment, training or network execution. Only this review file is newly written.
artifact_layout: Actual raw traces are the guidance and state_alias arrays in trace.json; separate guidance_trace.json/state_alias_trace.json do not exist.

independent_checks.method_ast_check: Parsed each saved source class/method and checked its AST serialization against the run manifest, including method line bounds. Runner extraction copies method bodies unchanged; it removes selected class inheritance/decorators and bypasses constructors/imports. This is method-level native code, not a full native runtime.
independent_checks.paired_order_controls: For both multiroot-depth1 and single-root-depth2 order pairs, the full per-action recorded state, prompt and response delta are identical after matching action token. Selected root evaluation and selected path are also identical.
independent_checks.object_identity_limit: parent_child_key_elements_same_object is a recorded runtime identity check supported by the inspected shallow-copy/append code; JSON serialization cannot independently reconstruct object identity.

verified_operator_findings.guidance: The singleton returns no plan update. Both nondefault order pairs keep the same safe selected action/path but return guidance for rejected C when C is last and rejected B when B is last. This supports order-dependent global-last-delta routing, not action harm.
verified_operator_findings.state_alias: Native shallow synthesis and copying only conversation_history mutate the parent key_elements. Deepcopy of synthesis input prevents parent mutation while preserving identical child content.
verified_operator_findings.full_tree_negative_control: With the fixed nonempty factual axtree, all three arms retain byte-identical full world-model and default action prompts.
verified_operator_findings.empty_tree_edge_case: Keeping axtree_txt present but empty causes the native world-model prompt to fall back to key_elements: shallow and unrelated-copy arms change the sibling prompt; deepcopy does not. The default action prompt stays byte-identical in every arm because it checks key presence, including an empty value.
verified_operator_findings.factual_scope: State-alias calls isolate the synthesis operator. They do not execute a complete beam-selection episode; immediately risk-pruned candidates do not pass this synthesis path. No claim of physical state mutation follows.

native_vs_harness.default_label: default_singleton_depth1 is only the native branch-count/depth structural control, not a complete default deployment Clean run.
native_vs_harness.configuration_difference: Harness world-model enable_long_term_prediction=True; the inspected official config.yaml has enable_long_term_prediction=False.
native_vs_harness.risk_and_policy_substitution: Harness policies are empty and policy IDs are synthetic. Fixed _simulate_api responses directly set parsed-delta fixtures; original model generation, response parsing and rule-based risk-score calculation are not executed.
native_vs_harness.other_substitutions: Benchmark adapter, child proposals, history, logging, filtered storage and PlanMonitor are explicit harness services. PolicyManager is absent. Native simulate/_create_prompt execute only against the local fixed-response endpoint.
native_vs_harness.multiroot_boundary: Requires an explicit candidate list and n_root greater than one through the public wrapper API. The checked WASP call supplies one action; metadata and web_agent_prompt do not create additional roots.
native_vs_harness.depth2_boundary: Single-root depth2 with three fixed child proposals is a supported nondefault structural setting. with_plan depth retains its independent default of one, enabling latest-descendant guidance fallback.
native_vs_harness.reference_boundary: No reference persistence or reload is exercised. The previous source-only show_policy_references=False and separate live-policy-object limits remain unchanged.

official_consumer_source_only.route: next_action calls evaluate_action_risk_with_plan at1018; at1034-1057 it invokes the plan LLM and assigns current_plan before regeneration decisions at1130-1172; at639-643 a subsequent action prompt reads current_plan; reset clears it at1238.
official_consumer_source_only.execution_limit: Only inspected source. No actual plan string was generated, persistent benchmark plan changed, subsequent policy action sampled or task executed by this probe.

claims_supported: A reproducible nondefault branch-guidance routing behavior with fixed per-action responses.
A shallow nested-list ownership defect and a conditional empty-tree world-model-prompt effect.
A source-confirmed official downstream plan consumer.
claims_not_supported: Normal guidance about rejected risk is not by itself contamination.
No pretrained world-model error, controllable adversarial input, task harm, actual safety degradation, attack success rate, useful deployed defense or generalization.
The deepcopy control isolates ownership; it is not a measured task-level defense.
Removing all rejected-branch guidance would discard legitimate safety information and is not justified by these findings.
No factual/progress contamination from an injected progress_step: that field is absent from the current native prompt and this probe.
decision: Accept the bounded implementation finding and preserve default/full-tree negative controls. No new task experiment or core security claim follows without a realistic restricted intervention, correct attribution target, competent Clean and independently measured real utility.
